text:
morgan: heads-up — we've got a small but consistent report from a partner: after a mid-request model swap + client reconnect the provisional token counter shows a transient extra credit (looks like ~1-3k tokens) that never reconciles. stack: streaming chat -> tool invocation -> client retry.
raj: can you paste the minimal repro or logs? do we have request_ids or session ids for hits?

morgan: captured one trace. request_id=rx-9887, session=svc-42. timeline: stream starts, toolcall invoked, model swap (canary->stable) mid-flight, client reconnects and retries, stream resumes, final ack shows more tokens charged than sum of tokens in responses.
tara: ugh. is this the same as the prefix-ownership edgecases we saw last quarter? or a different class (snapshot vs provisional double-claim)?

morgan: different enough — looks like a snapshot/stale-suffix got reattributed plus the ephemeral toolcall accounting counted again when the resumed session re-applied a provisional patch. suspect race between resume-ledger stitch and toolcall finalization.

raj: can you share the ledger query you used? i want to see confirmed vs provisional spikes.

morgan: here. query used to get the window around the trace:
```sql
SELECT ts, kind, token_delta, metadata->>'session' AS session
FROM token_ledger
WHERE request_id = 'rx-9887'
ORDER BY ts ASC;
```
results: provisional entries at ts=6009991236 (prefix capture +1200), toolcall provisional at 6009991238 (+900), then resume-stitch at 6009991240 (+1400), final confirm at 6009991246 (-2400) but UI shows provisional total + extra +200 that never cleared.

ops-bot: deploy-hook: new routing canary rolled at 6009980000 — not related? :rotating_light:

tara: hypothesis: resume flow replays a snapshot that still carries a short-lived provisional delta; when toolcall finalizes it applies its own confirm delta without dedupe key. we should check idempotency keys for snapshot vs toolcall confirms.

raj: agreed. quick mitigation: mark resume-path confirms to require an explicit ledger idempotency token that includes "snapshot-version" + session-id. if missing, make it provisional-only and wait for toolcall confirm to reconcile. That avoids double-confirming.

morgan: sounds reasonable. how invasive is adding that to the resume pipeline?

tara: not huge. two changes: (1) add idempotency header propagation from client session through snapshot resume, (2) change console UX so provisional vs confirmed tokens are visible per-request (showing transient provisional spikes) — that helps support triage.

raj: can we add a quick alert rule for when provisional > confirmed by > 500 tokens for same request within 30s? ops wants to catch these early.

morgan: on it. i'll open a PR for the resume idempotency key and a follow-up for the console flag. will include the sample trace and the query.

tara: also add unit tests around toolcall confirm reconciliation (simulate replayed snapshot + delayed tool confirm). i can take that.

morgan: thanks — tagging @raj for review when PR is up. :thumbsup:

raj: cool. one more ask: can we log the "dedupe-key" used at confirm time into the trace (non-PII) so we can map ledger rows -> traces automatically? that would massively speed debugging.

morgan: good idea, i'll include.

ops-bot: note: ticket created INF-2741 (investigate resume-ledger double-provisional)

morgan: updating ticket with repro and queries now. will ping when PR links available.
